verifications.claim: According to family statements, Chuck Norris passed away at age 86 on Thursday, March 19, 2026, in Hawaii following a sudden, undisclosed medical emergency.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Chuck Norris died Thursday morning at age 86... hospitalized in Hawaii earlier in the week after an undisclosed medical emergency'; R2: 'sudden passing of our beloved Chuck Norris yesterday morning... hospitalised in Hawaii'; R3: 'died after facing complications with a sudden hospitalization... hospitalized in Hawaii... on the island of Kauai'
verifications.reasoning: Facts supported (age, Thursday death inferred as March 19 from dates, Hawaii hospitalization/medical emergency), but family statements do not explicitly include date, location, or 'medical emergency' (those from TMZ/Variety); described in broader terms by articles.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris was surrounded by family.
